title: Detail Reading
description: Locate and transcribe a small reference code among specification sections using a contextual overview and native-resolution detail crops.

presentation.title: Find the tiny detail
presentation.label: Fine print
presentation.see: Start with the whole poster. Zoom only when the requested field is too small, keeping its label and section heading in the crop.
presentation.arrange: Keep the overview beside useful recent crops. Preserve original characters and source coordinates.
presentation.read: Match section and label, then transcribe the exact code. Preserve case, hyphens and leading zeros.

case.question: What is the Calibration reference in the SERVICE & TRACEABILITY section of this product specification poster? Return only the exact code.

title: Read a form field
description: Pair a business form label with its exact value despite neighboring reference fields.

presentation.title: Read the right field
presentation.label: Forms
presentation.see: Read the complete form before choosing a value. If needed, crop the label and value together.
presentation.arrange: Keep columns, field boundaries and the page overview intact so neighboring identifiers stay distinct.
presentation.read: Pair the requested label with its own value. Check nearby fields before returning the exact identifier.

case.question: What is the purchase order number on this invoice?

title: Read a grouped bar chart
description: Match bar colors to a legend, read category values, and answer a simple comparison or difference.

presentation.title: Let the chart speak
presentation.label: Charts
presentation.see: Keep original colors, category labels and axis units. Inspect a bar pair or legend only when it is unclear.
presentation.arrange: Preserve the full chart as context; retain the legend and nearby ticks in detail views.
presentation.read: Match the series to its legend, read values with units, then compute the requested comparison.

case.question: In March, how many more physical books than digital books were borrowed? Answer with the number only.

title: Table Reasoning
description: Filter table rows by several conditions and total the requested numeric column while ignoring distractor records and measures.

presentation.title: Follow the right rows
presentation.label: Tables
presentation.see: Read headers before numbers. Crop a row with its identifier, filter fields and target measure when necessary.
presentation.arrange: Preserve row alignment and column structure. Keep the overview available while checking a detail.
presentation.read: Apply every filter, collect values from the correct column, and verify the selected rows before summing.

case.question: What is the total number of units for orders where Depot is North, Category is Kits, and Status is Shipped? Add the Units column for matching rows only. Return only the number.

title: Color + shape counting
description: Count a requested color and shape using a compartment-by-compartment visual tally while excluding partial matches.

presentation.title: Count without losing track
presentation.label: Counting
presentation.see: Keep true RGB colors and object contours. Inspect only shapes whose color or boundary remains ambiguous.
presentation.arrange: Use the scene's compartments or nonoverlapping scan bands. A crop shows existing objects, not new ones.
presentation.read: Match both color and shape. Count region by region, check boundaries, then combine the subtotals.

case.question: How many orange triangles are there across all four compartments? Count only pieces that are both orange and triangular. Answer with only the integer.

title: Image Comparison
description: Compare aligned before and after desk scenes and identify the one object that moved or was replaced.

presentation.title: Spot what changed
presentation.label: Before & after
presentation.see: Keep the input order, colors and aspect ratios. Compare both scenes before requesting matched detail crops.
presentation.arrange: Place the two views in an indexed, two-column comparison sheet while retaining source identities.
presentation.read: Align stable landmarks. For a moved object, confirm both its old location and its new location.

case.question: The first image is BEFORE and the second image is AFTER. Exactly one item has moved on this desk; all other items stayed in place. Which item moved? Answer only with its color and common object name.

title: Temporal Order
description: Find the event immediately before or after an anchor in timestamped scene frames.

presentation.title: Put the story in order
presentation.label: Time & events
presentation.see: Retain the supplied event frames and timestamps. Inspect a specific source frame only when the event is unclear.
presentation.arrange: Arrange frames in a three-column, time-labeled sheet. Read timestamps rather than guessing from tile position.
presentation.read: Locate the anchor event, then inspect its immediate neighbor. Distinguish an action from a persistent state.

case.question: In this sequence, what happened immediately before the box was taped shut at 00:12? Answer with the letter of the matching event.

title: Which objects stayed still?
description: Compare labeled colored objects across five temporal frames, including an object that moves and returns to its starting position.

presentation.title: Notice who stayed still
presentation.label: Motion
presentation.see: Keep all supplied frames in time order. Preserve the scene's colors and object identities.
presentation.arrange: Use a time-labeled contact sheet so the same object can be compared across several moments.
presentation.read: Track every object's position relative to stable landmarks. Returning to the start does not mean staying still.

case.question: Which labeled objects remained at the same position in every one of the five frames? An object that moves and returns to its starting position does not count. Return only the labels in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.

title: Multi-page QA
description: Locate the relevant pages in a short report and combine two visible facts into a concise answer.

presentation.title: Connect the pages
presentation.label: Documents
presentation.see: Retain the small report's page pool. Locate evidence by section headings and printed page numbers.
presentation.arrange: Keep pages individually addressable, with each fact tied to its source, period and units.
presentation.read: Find the required facts on their own pages, check that their entities and units agree, then combine them.

case.question: According to the April 2026 report, how many additional accepted Atlas kits were needed to meet the monthly target? Answer with the number only.

title: Locate a dashboard button
description: Resolve repeated GUI controls using task and environment labels, then return a normalized click point in the original screenshot.

presentation.title: Point to the right control
presentation.label: Interfaces
presentation.see: Inspect the original screenshot. Crop only when a repeated label or control is too small to distinguish.
presentation.arrange: Preserve source geometry and individually addressable views. Never rearrange interface fragments into a sheet.
presentation.read: Match the row and section qualifiers, then choose the control's center and return a normalized source point.

case.question: Locate the Retry button in the Meridian sync row whose environment is Production. Return its center as normalized (x, y) coordinates in the original screenshot.
